title: Yellow Corn Flour, Fine Meal, Enriched

content.title: About
content.content: Yellow corn flour, fine meal, enriched is a dry product made from whole yellow corn kernels that are milled to a fine texture and fortified with vitamins and minerals. It is used in baking, porridge preparation, breading, and as a thickener for sauces.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Yellow corn is rich in carotenoids, which give it a bright color.
Enrichment typically adds iron, vitamin B1 (thiamine) and folic acid.
Corn flour is a staple in Mexican cuisine for making tortillas and tamales.
Fine milling provides a smoother texture in finished dishes.
Corn flour is naturally gluten‑free, making it suitable for gluten‑free diets.

items.title: Rich source of carbohydrates
items.content: Provides a quick source of energy through complex carbohydrates.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports normal bowel function and promotes satiety.

items.title: Enriched with vitamins and minerals
items.content: Added iron, thiamine and folic acid help maintain blood formation and nervous system health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Corn flour contains little fat, making it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Safe for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to corn products.

items.title: High carbohydrate content
items.content: May affect blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.

items.title: Nutrient loss with heat
items.content: Certain vitamins can degrade during prolonged cooking.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Use the flour for baking bread, flatbreads, muffins, as a coating for meat, to thicken soups and sauces, and in preparing corn porridge or polenta.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For long‑term storage, keep refrigerated to prevent fat oxidation.
